scenes.narration: Domi is a diary for home-visit healthcare that refills itself when patients cancel.

scenes.on_screen: A cancellation costs a home-visit practice more than a clinic
scenes.narration: A cancellation costs a home-visit practice more than a clinic, because the clinician is already on the road and the gap is too short to fill by ringing round.

scenes.on_screen: The refill engine ranks candidates by clinical priority, locality, days waiting and preferred clinician, and shows the reasons for each
scenes.narration: The refill engine ranks candidates by clinical priority, locality, days waiting and preferred clinician, and shows the reasons for each.

scenes.on_screen: Patients can cancel by texting CANCEL, which starts the refill with no staff involved
scenes.narration: Patients can cancel by texting CANCEL, which starts the refill with no staff involved.

scenes.on_screen: Domi acts on the gap by finding who fits it, asking them by text and booking the first yes
scenes.narration: Plenty of systems keep a diary; Domi acts on the gap by finding who fits it, asking them by text and booking the first yes.
